== Japanese text and banned faces (swccg-guild/work#274) ==
Q6 of the Premiere QA follow-ups, 11 November 2026:
* Rotated the 8 location faces that were sideways, so they read upright.
* Removed 38 faces from their card articles: 37 watermarked SWCCGcards scans and the Rebel Trooper photo with a seller logo. 36 of them also came off the Image cells on this set page. Blaster Rifle (Dark) and Tatooine: Jawa Camp (Dark) have no Image cell here. The files are still on the wiki, and #240 will add clean photos later.
* Added the Japanese title, card text, lore and translation to 56 card pages. The text comes from each card's Japanese Premiere page. I compared each Two-Player face with its Premiere twin line by line, and they print the same text. Comlink's last line follows the Two-Player face, which reads 配備コストは通常通り支払う。 because the Premiere photo cuts that line off.
* Typed the text for 7 more cards from their own Two-Player faces. Six have no Premiere twin: Luke, Vader, Run Luke, Run!, Vader's Obsession, Death Star: Level 6 Core Shaft Corridor and Death Star: Docking Control Room 327. The seventh is CZ-3, whose Premiere page has no Japanese text yet.
Each edit passed the style check with 0 flags. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]], 11 November 2026 (UTC)
